draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.18, the 100th-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 9th of 16 at TE. He went 34th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (100th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing standouts: 40-yard dash (81st percentile), three-cone (90th percentile). College production: 657 receiving yards in 2022, 4th of 16 TEs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the Detroit Lions. 42 career games and 39 starts over 3 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 5 AV in 2025 against a career-best 9 in 2023. Strengths in 2025: drop rate 0.0% (96th percentile), catch rate 81.6% (94th percentile), yards per target 10.0 (93rd percentile). Played 9 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-3 tight end who played: 489 receiving yards against a median of 196, above the norm.
